summary: Iteration 4 — Refer & Earn + OTP provider abstraction tested end-to-end. ALL features VERIFIED. Backend: 29/29 pytest pass (22 pre-existing + 7 new referral tests in /app/backend/tests/test_referrals.py). New tests cover: (1) /me/referrals shape — name-based code NAME-XXXX format, share_text contains code, stats keys all present, reward_pct=0.10. (2) Signup with referral_code at OTP verify creates referral record with status='signed_up' and referred_name on referrer's list. (3) POST /me/referrals/apply success path, self-referral 400 ('Cannot use your own code'), invalid code 404, duplicate-apply 400. (4) Full lifecycle: signup-with-code → create app → submit → referral becomes 'applied' on referrer side → mark-disbursed with ₹50L → app moves to stage='disbursement' with all 8 stages_completed → referral becomes 'disbursed' with reward_amount=5000 (0.10% of 50L) → referrer stats.total_earned increments by 5000. Frontend smoke: brand-new mobile (9777781406) → OTP 123456 → onboarding (filled name/city/state/dob/gender/pan) → home → home-quick-refer present, taps to /refer → refer-code shows 'USER-D03A' (valid NAME-XXXX format), refer-copy/refer-share-whatsapp/refer-share-more/refer-total-earned (₹0)/refer-pending-earned (₹0)/refer-empty-cta ('Invite on WhatsApp')/refer-back all PRESENT. Profile tab → profile-link-refer present → navigates to /refer correctly. OTP screen has optional otp-referral-input — leaving it blank completes login successfully. NO regressions in OTP/auth/applications/banks/promise.

action_items: (LOW, OPTIONAL UX ENHANCEMENT) Name-based referral code is generated at OTP signup time using the `name` passed to /api/auth/otp/verify. Current /app/frontend/app/auth/otp.tsx does NOT pass `name` during OTP verify (name is collected later in /onboarding). Result: the first referral code falls back to `USER-XXXX` instead of `RAVIKU-XXXX`. To honor the spec example (RAVIKU-0327), either (a) collect name on /auth/login alongside mobile and pass through to OTP verify, or (b) regenerate the referral code inside PUT /me/profile when `name` is set for the first time AND user has a USER-prefixed code. Strictly cosmetic — does not break any functional flow.
(LOW, carried over) Replace deprecated `shadow*` style props with `boxShadow`/`elevation`.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/applications/{id}/mark-disbursed is currently user-token gated (any logged-in user can mark their own app disbursed). Note in code says 'in production this would be admin-gated' — confirming this is acceptable for this iteration.
server.py: _ensure_referral_code generates code only once (idempotent — good). However once user is created with name=None at OTP signup, code stays USER-XXXX forever. See action item above.
server.py: REFERRAL_PCT loaded from env with default 0.001 (0.10%) — verified in test_lifecycle: ₹50L * 0.001 = ₹5000.
server.py: referrals.referred_user_id has unique index — guarantees one referral per referred user; matches the 'duplicate apply rejected' behavior in /me/referrals/apply.
All MongoDB _id fields are excluded via _clean() and explicit {_id: 0} projections — no ObjectId serialization issues.
